title: Theological vocabulary in context
subtitle: Read recurrent words as phrases inside an argument.
overview: Theological vocabulary becomes reliable only in context. Learn high-frequency words with their common constructions and paragraph functions.
A word study begins with the passage in front of you; it does not begin by importing every possible use from elsewhere.

sections.title: Learn the phrase
rows: in Christ; a significant prepositional phrase

items.grc: ἡ χάρις τοῦ θεοῦ ἐπεφάνη σωτήριος πᾶσιν ἀνθρώποις.
items.en: The grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all people.

items.grc: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς τὸν υἱὸν ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον.
items.en: The one believing in the Son has eternal life.
